existing_group_assignments.rationale: Decreased ionotropic GABA receptor chloride channel conductance shares the same GABA-gated chloride channel object as the increased chloride conductance and activation events but is a distinct process and direction, so it is flagged for curator review.
Liver dysfunction is closely related to liver injury/hepatotoxicity, although it is not a strict synonym, so this is a borderline assignment.

new_groups.rationale: Both concern the ionotropic GABA-A receptor, one as inhibition and the other as decreased chloride channel conductance.
All concern hemocyanin but describe distinct processes (mRNA expression, oxygen binding capacity, oxidation of the active site).
